description: This file contains functions and logic for dynamically loading and resolving channel configuration schemas, including handling module import graphs, environment-specific loading via bun or jiti, and exporting an async function to load a module and extract schema data.

methods.name: isBuiltChannelConfigSchema
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a built channel config schema object.

methods.name: resolveConfigSchemaExport
methods.description: Resolves and extracts the channel config schema from an imported module.

methods.name: resolveRepoRoot
methods.description: Resolves the repository root directory based on the current file location.

methods.name: resolvePackageRoot
methods.description: Finds the root directory of the package containing the given module path.

methods.name: shouldRetryViaIsolatedCopy
methods.description: Determines if a module load error warrants retrying with an isolated copy.

methods.name: isMissingExecutableError
methods.description: Checks if an error indicates a missing executable (ENOENT).

methods.name: resolveImportCandidates
methods.description: Generates possible source file paths based on a base path and known extensions.

methods.name: resolveRelativeImportPath
methods.description: Resolves a relative import specifier to an actual file path if it exists.

methods.name: collectRelativeImportGraph
methods.description: Collects all files in the import graph starting from an entry point.

methods.name: resolveCommonAncestor
methods.description: Finds the common ancestor directory for a set of paths.

methods.name: copyModuleImportGraphWithoutNodeModules
methods.description: Copies the import graph of a module into a temporary isolated directory.

methods.name: loadChannelConfigSurfaceModule
methods.description: Main exported async function to load a channel config schema module, with fallback to isolated copy if needed.
